BundleInfo.name: ChimeraX-DaQRotFix
BundleInfo.Author: Genki Terashi
BundleInfo.Description: An independent ChimeraX extension for rapid, density-guided correction of rotamer outliers. Requires ISOLDE. Enumerates canonical rotamers and performs probability-ordered local ISOLDE MDFF annealing and minimization trials with a restrained backbone. The outlier threshold is configurable and the active region is focused.
